body:
## Context

GitHub issue #498, ESCALATED in the 1.11.0 pre-release issue review as the only in-window REGRESSION vs the last shipped release: fail-open on a deny path. A/B against v1.10.0's rails-checker on identical inputs (rail `src/**/test/*.mjs`, ungated branch, absent target `src/new.bundle`):

  v1.10.0 DENY → main ALLOW (REGRESSION): {"filePath":"src/new.bundle"}, {"file":"src/new.bundle"}, {"files":["src/new.bundle"]}, {"edits":[{"filePath":"src/new.bundle"}]}
  v1.10.0 ALLOW → main DENY (improvement, KEEP): {"target":"src/new.bundle"}, {"targetDir":"src/new.bundle"}

Mechanism (verified on main @ 59bb1e71): plugins/adlc-opencode/rails-checker.mjs:733-735 — `claimedFile` is true when a FILE-SPECIFIC key plus a dotted leaf licenses the extension guess in namesAFile (:358-365) for an ABSENT path, selecting ancestors:'literal'; 'literal' sets throughDoubleStar=false (:600), so ancestorWalk refuses to let an anchored `**` absorb the target's last segment (:554-555). At v1.10.0 this branch called railHit with ancestors defaulting true and extractTargets already collected all four shapes, so they denied. Introduced by #490 (e87c933d), narrowed but not closed by #502. #540 did not touch this surface.

SPEC DECISION (locked with Chris 2026-08-23): revert the ungated-branch behavior to v1.10.0's deny for these shapes. The over-denial this trades back in was the actual shipped, field-tolerated behavior of every release through 1.10.0, and benign ungated tools should not carry file-path args at all. The existing test pin at plugins/adlc-opencode/test/rails-checker.test.mjs:843-864 (which pins ALLOW for exactly these shapes) is AMENDED DELIBERATELY under this decision — flip those assertions to deny and cite this ticket in the test comment so the litigation trail survives.

Reachability context for the PR body (not a reason to soften the fix): the exploit needs an operator-vouched ADLC_UNGATED_TOOLS entry that materializes file trees (the built-in ungated set does not), and the file.edited watcher backstop does NOT remove newly created untracked files (quarantineAndRestore's `git checkout HEAD --` fails for untracked; warning only, watcher.mjs:135). Watcher hardening is OUT OF SCOPE here.

## What to change

Drop the fileKeyed extension license on the UNGATED branch only (the absent-path extension guess must not select ancestors:'literal' there), restoring ancestors:true semantics for the four regression shapes, while KEEPING the target/targetDir improvement (those must continue to deny). Do not touch the gated branch's semantics.

## Acceptance criteria

1. All four regression shapes DENY again on the ungated branch (absent dotted path under an interior-wildcard rail), pinned by tests that name the v1.10.0-parity rationale. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/rails-checker.test.mjs` exits 0 with the amended + new assertions present.
2. target/targetDir still DENY (the in-window improvement is not reverted). verify: same suite pins both.
3. Gated-branch behavior unchanged (existing gated tests untouched and green). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/*.test.mjs` exits 0.
4. Mutation coverage: reverting the fix (re-adding the extension license on the ungated branch) reddens at least one test. verify: plant-and-revert documented in the PR body; `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main` exits 0.
title: opencode: restore the v1.10.0 deny for absent dotted paths on the ungated branch (#498)
